 4-year-old critically injured, 3 children hospitalized in crash during police chase in Loganville
 Updated on: November 16, 2026 / 3:38 PM EST 
 / CBS Atlanta
 Add CBS News on Google 
 Multiple children have been transported to the hospital when a vehicle fleeing law enforcement struck another vehicle on U.S. Highway 78 in Loganville, city officials said. 
 The crash happened at Commerce Drive after the pursuit entered Loganville, Police Chief M.D. Lowry said in a city notice . 
 According to authorities, officers with multiple law enforcement agencies were chasing a stolen Hyundai Elantra traveling on GA 10 West. As the stolen car approached the intersection of GA 10 West and GA 81, it hit the rear of a Nissan Altima and then struck a Chrysler Pacifica.
 The stolen car was eventually stopped when a deputy with the Bartow County Sheriff's Office performed a PIT maneuver on it. The driver, who officials have not named, was taken into custody. The individual was taken to Piedmont Walton Hospital.
 Four children who were in the Pacifica have been taken to Children's Healthcare of Atlanta. Authorities say that a 4-year-old boy was airlifted to the hospital in critical condition. The conditions of the three others, a 2-year-old girl, 7-year-old boy, and 9-year-old boy, is not known at this time.
 The driver of the Nissan Altima was also transported to Piedmont Walton Hospital.
 Highway 78 was shut down, and the Georgia State Patrol was investigating the crashes, Loganville officials said
